<a name="Resolve"></a>
## func [Resolve](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/tako.go#L46>)

```go [tako.go]
func Resolve[T any](c contracts.Container) T
```

Resolve lazily resolves a service from the container. It returns the zero value if it fails. This generic wrapper removes the need for boilerplate type assertion and error handling.

```
bus := tako.Resolve[contracts.EventBus](app.Container())
```

```go [tako.go]
func Run(app *foundation.Application) error
```

Run boots the application and starts the appropriate Kernel based on os.Args.
